name: Gamma
summary: Gamma is an AI-native productivity application for generating and editing presentations and related documents/websites from prompts or uploaded files, with export and sharing options and a public generation API.

product.one_liner: AI presentation and document creation from prompts, outlines, or uploaded files
product.description: Gamma provides a web product for AI-assisted creation of presentations and related formats (including documents and websites on product surfaces). Official presentation product materials describe generating decks from prompts, outlines, or uploaded Word/PDF/Google Docs, applying themes, editing with AI assistance, presenting or sharing live links, and exporting to PowerPoint, PDF, or Google Slides. A free plan with starter AI credits is described. Developer documentation describes a public API to generate presentations, documents, websites, and social posts programmatically.
key_capabilities: AI generation of presentations from prompts or documents
present in-product, share live links, export to PPT/PDF/Google Slides
related creation surfaces for documents and websites
public generations API for presentations and other formats
free tier with starter AI credits; paid plan tiers on pricing page

market.primary_persona: Knowledge workers, consultants, marketers, educators, and sales teams creating decks and related collateral
market.problem: Creating polished presentations and related collateral from scratch is slow; users want AI help to turn prompts or existing documents into structured, presentable decks they can edit and export

business_model.notes: Official pricing page lists Free plus paid individual tiers (Plus, Pro, Ultra) and team/business evaluation via contact sales. Free includes limited AI generation (e.g. cards-per-prompt limits). Paid tiers unlock higher generation limits, branding controls, analytics, custom domains, and API access on higher plans per developer docs. Exact seat/month dollar figures are not transcribed here pending a stable pricing-page snapshot.

ai_profile.model_strategy: Product experience centers on model-backed generation of copy, layouts, and visuals for presentations and related artifacts. Pricing/product materials reference access to advanced AI models on higher tiers; the company does not position itself as a foundation-model lab in attached primary sources.
ai_profile.data_advantage: Potential advantage from presentation templates, layout systems, and usage loops; extent of proprietary model or data advantage is not fully public in attached sources
ai_profile.notes: AI capability is structural: without generative creation of decks/content, the product collapses toward a conventional slide editor or template site.

product.rationale: Judgment: coherent AI presentation/document creation workflow (prompt/upload → generate → edit → present/export) with clear consumer surface and API. Strong for the category, not exceptional beyond peers.

market.rationale: Judgment: AI presentation tools are a clear, active application category with identifiable peers. Capped at 4: no independent category-level demand report attached (company materials alone cannot justify 5).

business_model.rationale: Judgment: public Free plus paid tiers and documented API gating provide a concrete monetization path; dollar prices not fully transcribed in this entry.

technology.rationale: Judgment (application layer): meaningful product orchestration for generation, layout, themes, export, and API versus AI-presentation peers; not frontier-model ownership. Within-layer frame only.

growth.rationale: Not scored: marketing generation/user counters are not treated as verified growth metrics; no sourced ARR or seats attached.

competitive_position.rationale: Judgment (application layer): visible contender among AI presentation tools (e.g. Beautiful.ai, Tome); relative share and defensibility not measured. Broader productivity suites and general AI assistants are adjacent, not peer-set equals.
